Question
========
If the incomes of all people in a country grow by 10%, what happens to the Gini coefficient?

Answerlist
----------
* It stays the same, although the absolute gap grows
* It rises
* It falls
* It cannot be computed anymore

Solution
========
The Gini is a relative measure. Equal percentage growth leaves it unchanged, while absolute differences in money increase.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
